[ITST.2.2] Filename convention (binaries):
- impl: `test_<area>_<scenario>.c` —
  `test_engine_basic.c`, `test_dispatcher_log.c`, etc.
  `_basic` is the smoke-level scenario; `_<specific>`
  variants land as cases grow enough bulk to split.
- spec: one binary per spec area —
  `test_log_spec.c`, `test_ttl_spec.c`, etc.

Inside both, every scenario function follows the
naming scheme in [ITST.5.3].
